learnings.title: Altseason 10 indicators: free keyless source audit and 2020-2025 calibration protocol
learnings.claim: Ten candidate public URLs are documented with keyless availability caveats. Public URL does not imply complete 2020-2025 coverage. CoinGecko global current data cannot prove historical dominance or TOTAL3; Binance OI history is restricted to recent history; exact historical DXY and daily Altseason Index archives remain unverified.
learnings.decision: No invented 0-100 values. For each indicator: reconstruct UTC daily x, freeze train-only lo=p20 and hi=p80 of preceding 730 daily observations (>=500 valid; at least 80% daily coverage), update only at quarterly walk-forward boundaries; monotonic up score=100*clip((x-lo)/(hi-lo)); down=100*clip((hi-x)/(hi-lo)). Index and breadth have natural 0/100 limits. If p20>=p80, unavailable history, or data lookahead risk, output N/A. Funding/OI requires historical OI and validated two-tail shape; N/A meanwhile. Hold out rolling next 90 days, every 90 days, from 2020-2025; do not calculate early folds lacking 730 days. Compare p10/p90 vs p20/p80 on train only, freeze choice before test. Prevent survivorship, data leakage, mixed providers, and unstable symbols.
learnings.next_measurement: Fetch URLs without secrets, archive source responses and daily coverage by year, establish valid as_of, then run 730d/90d walk-forward with baseline and report false alarms, precision/recall, and coverage. Any unverified endpoint/period remains blocked.
failure_history: No 2020-2025 full raw history downloaded or backtest run in this task.
No verified keyless 2020-2025 series for exact DXY, daily Altseason Index, full-market BTC dominance/TOTAL3, and historical OI.

fallback_history: If full historical series cannot be obtained, retain N/A rather than interpolate or fabricate a score.
